title: Concurrent adapter.port.with async contexts interfere
recommended_action: Replace global async scoped stacks with explicit instance-scoped context or supported async-context adapter; add interleaving tests
r2_evidence: port.with and bundle.with still share mutable stack across overlapping async tasks; Node repro fails

title: box.touch(key) without ttl silently removes a per-entry expiry
recommended_action: Preserve existing expires-at for no-TTL touch and specify refresh semantics
r2_evidence: set({ttl:1})->touch()->get preserves original absolute expiry; same Node repro now passes

title: Raw secret material embedded in long-lived Map cache keys
recommended_action: Avoid caching by raw secret string; use scoped crypto key handles with bounded lifecycle
r2_evidence: Secret label now HMAC-pseudonymous with per-Source random CryptoKey; no raw secret strings as Map keys

title: Access/refresh tokens persist to caller-supplied general-purpose Box without confidential-storage requirement
recommended_action: Define browser BFF/cookie and device secure-storage policies; separate session persistence capabilities
r2_evidence: General auth Session persists bearer material through caller-supplied Box; secure storage/BFF policy remains a deployment obligation

title: Cross-instance durable outbox updates have no atomicity guarantee without storage lock
recommended_action: Specify single-owner offline outbox vs distributed queue; require CAS/atomic lock for shared stores
r2_evidence: Fail-closed if store.lock absent; explicit guard local permits process-local single-owner use, not shared multi-instance CAS

title: Rate-limiter capacity churn evicts an active bucket and permits another request
recommended_action: Never silently use capped local limiter as security boundary; handle saturated keys and distributed backend
r2_evidence: Capacity churn scenario fails closed; regression Node repro passes

title: Watch decoder rejection is not consumed, causing unhandled promise rejection
recommended_action: Explicitly catch/report async decode and observer faults, add failure-path test
r2_evidence: Unhandled rejection stopped in Node repro; observable error delivery now requires driver flush

title: box.all/clear enumerate all keys and issue unbounded Promise.all
recommended_action: Bound concurrent I/O, add paginated/iterable APIs, document all() snapshot budget
r2_evidence: list.eachAsync bounds concurrency while keys() and all() still materialize unbounded inputs

title: X-Forwarded-For parsing is not a trusted-proxy identity policy
recommended_action: Require a verified ingress proxy chain before use for auth/rate limits
r2_evidence: facts defaults hops=0 using remote; valid only with externally verified trusted proxy count

title: URL origin guards are not a complete DNS-rebinding / server egress defense
recommended_action: Add network egress controls / resolved-IP policy for server-side user-supplied URLs
r2_evidence: URL guards do not replace egress ACL and DNS pinning for server-side arbitrary URLs

title: Uploaded archive omits bun.lock while gate requires frozen lockfile
recommended_action: Include bun.lock when shipping R1 evidence; record exact toolchain and peer resolution
r2_evidence: R2 ZIP still has no bun.lock; frozen package graph unreproducible

title: LCOV coverage script can treat empty totals as fully covered / misses full source inventory
recommended_action: Require nonempty expected source set and check missing files; preserve branch coverage
r2_evidence: New coverage inventory validation and tests but TypeScript 7/Bun integration not executed

title: Export proof scans names as text rather than verifying behavioral tests
recommended_action: Use contract-level tests and executable scenario matrix; retain API snapshot as shape check
r2_evidence: Static facade export proof remains shape/name oriented; behavior coverage still incomplete

title: Gate omits benchmark/stress/heap regression runs
recommended_action: Add measured perf/memory compatibility gates on fixed hardware runners
r2_evidence: No sustained load/heap/bench performance gate; new single JSON RSS test is not a service soak

title: fs.lines duplicates splitting already owned by engine-string
recommended_action: Delegate line parsing to string.lines while preserving final empty line policy
r2_evidence: fs.lines now delegates to string.lines

title: CLDR digits vs ISO/exact minor-unit exponent disagree for 16 currency codes
recommended_action: Formalize display digits vs storage/minor exponents, test the full currency inventory
r2_evidence: Display CLDR digits and exact currency minor precision contract remains unresolved

title: Flag images provenance is described only as carried over from previous projects
recommended_action: Record original licensing for each asset category; verify attribution and redistribution terms
r2_evidence: Flag provenance still only carried over from earlier projects

title: Zod compile uses dynamic codegen and costs bundle bytes under strict CSP
recommended_action: Test jitless/CSP and Hermes; avoid dragging compile into hot browser bundles by default
r2_evidence: Zod compile dynamic codegen/CSP and JS bundle cost still need platform tests

title: No web/mobile/desktop consumer projects included in uploaded ZIP
recommended_action: Cross-surface integration and runtime matrix builds using exact versions
r2_evidence: No Next/Expo/Electrobun consumer sources/build results in R2 ZIP

title: Asset payload is large on disk; runtime impact not measured
recommended_action: Verify code-split/lazy import and asset copy/pruning in end-user build
r2_evidence: Runtime asset memory/bundle tree-shaking not profiled

title: Presence sync replies may overwrite newer snapshot when arriving out of order
recommended_action: Monotonic sync generation/cancellation and replay-safe event merge; test delayed/out-of-order responses
r2_evidence: Two sync calls: newer response installs new-user then slower stale response replaces with old-user

title: Public API removals and required renderer/protocol change without consumer migration proof
recommended_action: Versioned migration aliases/docs, TS contract compile against Web/Mobile/Desktop and production bundle builds
r2_evidence: Protocol encoding and presence moved from socket to api; state binding needs injected renderer and socket.open requires protocol

title: Observer/decoder failures require flush to become observable and may be lost for uninstrumented custom Storage
recommended_action: Explicit onError sink plus watcher error contract; test custom drivers and update-loop failures
r2_evidence: driver records async observer failures; box.watch consumes promise tail; errors surfaced by flush only when invoked

title: Secret-key hardening changed WebCrypto hot paths; no p95/heap comparison
recommended_action: Bench HMAC and AES-GCM with realistic key/size patterns on Bun, browser and Hermes; keep security invariants
r2_evidence: macKey imports key on each call; seal computes pseudonymous HMAC label and caches derived AES key by opaque digest
